verdict.rationale: n8n docs explicitly describe a dedicated 'error workflow' feature that lets users control how n8n responds to a workflow execution failure, directly matching the ops story of dedicated error-handling paths, and community evidence confirms n8n retains historical execution data for debugging failed runs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of a notification action (e.g., Slack/email node) triggered from the error workflow, and independent hands-on confirmation that failure notifications work reliably in practice.
